definitions.explanation: The art of creating three-dimensional works by carving, modeling, or casting.
The act of creating sculpture or carving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{彫刻|ちょうこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are sculptures in the park.

examples.japanese: {彫刻|ちょうこく}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。

notes:
COMPOUND: {彫|ちょう} (carve) + {刻|こく} (engrave)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {彫刻|ちょうこく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to sculpt, carve)
- {彫刻|ちょうこく}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (sculptor)
- {彫刻|ちょうこく}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (sculpture, sculptural work)
- ⟦{木|き}{彫|ぼ}り→木彫り：07063_kibori⟧ (wood carving)
- ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧{彫刻|ちょうこく} (stone sculpture)
- ⟦{彫刻|ちょうこく}{刀|とう}→彫刻刀：26190_choukokutou⟧ (chisel)
